_comment: Engine adapters. Local-first defaults for Apple Silicon (no CUDA); vendor providers are opt-in via tools.local.json (gitignored). No adapter is required for the framework to validate.

translation._comment: `provider: claude` is the LLM-authored route (the create-closed-captions skill fills worksheets). `mt_baseline` is the OPT-IN machine-translation engine for the scripted/manual route (`project autopilot --mt` / `run_pipeline.sh`), which fills worksheets WITHOUT Claude tokens. null = auto-select the first installed MT engine; or pin one of engines/mt.py KNOWN_PROVIDERS (argos|ctranslate2|nllb|opus-mt) in the gitignored tools.local.json. HF is policy-blocked here — stage the MT model offline (OPERATING-GUIDE.md §6). MT-filled `en` still hits the human translation_qa gate; auto_translate targets skip it.

tts._comment: `per_language` picks the TTS ENGINE for a language whose provider `dub run` left unresolved (provider=None) — it is NOT the clone-vs-piper policy, and it is NOT what real `dub run` reads for fa/ur (that's the company.local.json `dubbing.voices` registry via resolve_dub_voice). This map is only consulted by `tts-sample` (the A/B evaluation tool). The SOURCE OF TRUTH for which languages are voice-cloned (XTTS off source/audio.wav) vs fixed-voice is company.default.json `dubbing.clone_languages`; `dub run` resolves provider=xtts+clone there BEFORE the engine layer ever consults this map, so for a clone language this map is never read — it only matters as documentation/fallback. Keep the two in sync (every clone language listed xtts here too) but change the policy in company config, not here. fa/ur are the sole fixed-voice PIPER exception (reverted from an MMS trial 2026-08-10 — human judged piper's quality better) — no XTTS coverage for them; every other language, including the default_provider fallback, is xtts.
tts._comment_xtts_worker: Defaults for the persistent XTTS daemon (engines/_xtts_client.py + .venv-xtts/xtts_worker.py). socket_path is set machine-locally in tools.local.json; these are the timeouts + the reference-clip trim length used by dubbing._clone_ref_trim.

distribution._comment: Phase 6 uploader/promoter adapters. Every platform here is OFF unless BOTH VIDTRANS_PUBLISH_ENABLED=1 (module) and VIDTRANS_EXTERNAL_WRITES=enabled (hook) are set. `sdk` is the Python import probed by `doctor` (absent SDK => graceful PublishDisabled, never a crash). `credentials_ref` names the env-var prefix (see .env.example).
